expectations.text: Output has a valid SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name and description
expectations.evidence: SKILL.md frontmatter has name: commit-message-drafter, description with triggering phrases and explicit negative scope (no git add/commit/push, no PR descriptions).

expectations.text: Uses the staged git diff explicitly as the input
expectations.evidence: Inputs section: 'Staged diff: git diff --staged (full patch) and git diff --staged --stat... Required. If empty, this is a stop condition — never falls back to unstaged changes.'

expectations.text: Validation bar matches the team's exact format: type(scope) subject, imperative mood, subject line under 72 chars, body explains why not what
expectations.evidence: Validation section has a regex check for subject shape, a ≤72-char mechanical check, an imperative-mood spot check against a disallowed-form list, and a 'body is not a diff echo' content check.

expectations.text: Names an explicit failure mode for an empty/missing staged diff
expectations.evidence: Failure modes: 'Nothing staged (git diff --staged empty) → stop immediately; tell the user to git add the intended files first. Never fall back...'

expectations.text: Is transparent about template provenance — states whether it used the blank template or a related catalog template, since this task has no close catalog match
expectations.evidence: RUN_NOTES.md explicitly documents falling back to blank-skill-template.md after checking all 13 catalog categories had no dev/git match; SKILL.md itself has no Attribution section (consistent with no template reuse), unlike the other two eval outputs which do.

expectations.text: No API keys, tokens, or credential values anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: Only dependency is the local git CLI already configured by the user; grep across output files found no credential-like values.
